notes: The 'console' surface (index.html) falls back to the 'snapshot' mirror (jsDelivr) when the live API is unreachable, via fetchWithMirror() in index.html. This is a runtime fallback relationship between two surfaces, not a resource-level in/exempt/todo decision, so it isn't expressed in the table below — see issue #139.

exempt.snapshot: time-dependent (relative to 'today'); a static mirror snapshot would go stale immediately

exempt.console: aggregate diagnostic endpoint, not a queryable resource; the landing page's hero tiles already surface it separately from the ENDPOINTS console
exempt.snapshot: time-dependent aggregate computed over the live dataset; would go stale immediately in a static mirror
a derived view over movies.json + tvshows.json; a third static file would just duplicate them (see #67)
exempt.mcp: MCP is the write surface (direct Postgres); search_content and get_timeline already cover cross-type reads (see #67)
